stem:
Meena lives in a small town in Rajasthan. She wants to keep her body and mind healthy.
Which of her daily habits best supports good health?

options.text: staying awake late at night watching videos on her phone
eating a balanced meal, sleeping on time, and playing outside with friends
eating only the sweets she likes most because they taste good
keeping her classroom clean but ignoring the broken furniture and unsafe corners

teacher.key_rationale: Good health of body and mind is supported by nutritious food, adequate sleep, physical activity, and positive relationships; option B combines these. A trades away needed sleep, C confuses taste with healthy food choice, and D treats surface cleanliness alone as sufficient while ignoring unsafe surroundings.
